description: PR footpaths is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.bizkaia.eus. Short-distance trails promoted by the Provincial Council of Bizkaia. Coverage: ES. Its keywords include pequeño recorrido, Armañon, gorbea, rutas, Natura2000, Urkiola. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, ATOM, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/es/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
